info.title: safe-grokbot-bridge
info.description:
A narrow, authenticated API that lets a remote AI agent work with this machine: read the folders it was given access to and their git history, see the coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes) running there, talk to them, and start new ones.

Usage notes:
- Every request except `GET /healthz` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Start with `GET /v1/info`: it lists the folders (workspaces) you may access and what you may do in each (`files`, `git`, `sessions`, `input`, `start`), plus the available agents.
- All paths are absolute. A session's `cwd` can be passed straight to the file and git endpoints.
- Agents work for minutes. After sending input, call `GET /v1/sessions/{id}?wait=60` to wait until the session stops working instead of polling in a tight loop.
- Errors have the shape `{"error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}`; the message says what to do.

get.summary: Liveness probe. Needs no token and reveals nothing.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of this API

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary:
Lists a directory in path order, page by page. Entries ignored by `.gitignore` or matching
the workspace's deny patterns (secrets such as `.env` files and keys) are left out.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of a directory inside a workspace with the `files` capability.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels to descend, 1–5 (default 1: direct children only).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries, 1–2000 (default 200).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Entries to skip, for the next page (use `next_offset` from the previous response).

403.description: Outside the workspaces, denied, or `files` not allowed

409.description: The directory was replaced during the listing; try again

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary:
Reads a range of lines from a text file. When `truncated` is true, continue with
`start_line = next_start_line`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of a text file inside a workspace with the `files` capability.

parameters.name: start_line
parameters.description: First line to return, 1-based (default 1).

parameters.name: max_lines
parameters.description: Number of lines to return, 1–4000 (default 400).

200.description: The requested lines of the file

400.description: Not a file, or `start_line` past the end

403.description: Outside the workspaces, denied, or `files` not allowed

409.description: The file was replaced while it was being opened; try again

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary: A diff with a summary (`--stat`) followed by the patch.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
Absolute path of a directory inside a git repository and a workspace with the `git`
capability.

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description:
Compare with this revision or range, e.g. `HEAD~3` or `main..feature`. Without it, the
working tree is compared with the index.

parameters.name: staged
parameters.description: Show staged changes (`git diff --cached`).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Limit the diff to this path, relative to `dir`.

400.description: Not a git repository or invalid parameters

403.description: Outside the workspaces or `git` not allowed

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

503.description: git cannot be run on this machine

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary: Commit history, one commit per line: `<hash>\t<ISO date>\t<author>\t<subject>`.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
Absolute path of a directory inside a git repository and a workspace with the `git`
capability.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of commits, 1–500 (default 30).

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description: Revision or range, e.g. `main`, `origin/main..HEAD` (default: `HEAD`).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only commits touching this path, relative to `dir`.

400.description: Not a git repository or invalid parameters

403.description: Outside the workspaces or `git` not allowed

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

503.description: git cannot be run on this machine

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description:
Absolute path of a directory inside a git repository and a workspace with the `git`
capability.

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description: Commit to show (default `HEAD`).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Limit the patch to this path, relative to `dir`.

get.summary:
Describes this machine: version, agents, the workspaces you may access and the limits.
Call this first.

200.description: This machine, its agents and the workspaces you may access

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary:
Lists agent sessions in the workspaces you may see: tmux sessions (including ones a person
started), headless sessions started through the bridge, and Claude Code / Codex sessions
running outside tmux. Check here before starting a new session in a folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only sessions whose working directory is under this absolute path.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

post.summary:
Starts an agent session in a folder. With `runner: "tmux"` the agent runs in a live terminal
a person can attach to; with `"headless"` every message is one non-interactive run. The
response comes right after the start: wait for the answer with
`GET /v1/sessions/{id}?wait=60`.

403.description: `start`, the agent or `bypass_permissions` not allowed in this folder

409.description: The conversation to resume is open elsewhere

413.description: The JSON body is larger than 1 MiB

415.description: The body is not sent as `Content-Type: application/json`

422.description: The JSON body does not match the schema (a missing or unknown field, or a wrong type)

429.description: Too many running sessions, or the rate limit or an authentication lockout (wait `Retry-After` seconds)

502.description: The agent exited right after starting (`agent_exited`), or tmux could not start the session (`tmux_failed`)

503.description: The agent or tmux is not installed

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

get.summary:
A session with its state, last answer and terminal screen. Use `wait` to long-poll until
the agent stops working.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session id from the session list

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Terminal lines to return in `screen` (1–2000, default 200).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description:
Wait up to this many seconds (max 90) while the session is `working`; returns as soon
as it is not.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

delete.summary:
Stops a session the bridge started: closes its tmux session or kills its running turn. The
conversation itself stays resumable via `agent_session_id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session id

200.description: Stopped; the final state and screen

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

502.description: The tmux session could not be stopped

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

post.summary:
Sends a message (`text`) or keystrokes (`keys`) to a session. In tmux, text is pasted as one
block and submitted; keys answer menus and permission prompts. Headless sessions take one
message per turn. Then wait for the answer with `GET /v1/sessions/{id}?wait=60`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session id

200.description: Delivered; the session as it is right after

413.description: The JSON body is larger than 1 MiB

415.description: The body is not sent as `Content-Type: application/json`

422.description: The JSON body does not match the schema (a missing or unknown field, or a wrong type)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or this address is blocked after failed authentications

502.description: Delivery to a session outside tmux failed

default.description: An unexpected error in the bridge; `error.message` says what failed

available.description: Whether the agent's command was found on this machine.

headless.description: Whether the agent can run headless (one non-interactive turn per message).

name.description: Name to use in `agent` when starting a session.

AgentKind.description:
Which agent CLI an agent entry drives. `generic` is any other terminal program; it can only
run in tmux.

Effort.description: Reasoning effort, mapped to each agent's own flag.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do about it.

FileContent.description: A range of lines from a text file.

end_line.description: Last line returned (1-based, inclusive); 0 for an empty file.

next_start_line.description: Where to continue reading when `truncated` is `true`.

path.description: Absolute path; pass it to `/v1/files/content` or, for directories, to `/v1/files`.

entries.description:
Entries in path order. Files ignored by `.gitignore` and paths matching the workspace's
deny patterns are left out.

limit.description: Maximum entries returned (the requested `limit`, capped at 2000).

next_offset.description: Pass this as `offset` to get the next entries (present when `truncated`).

note.description: Explains an empty, truncated or incomplete listing.

unreadable.description:
Entries that could not be read (e.g. permission denied); the listing is incomplete when
this is above 0.

command.description: The git command that ran, for reference.

output.description: Raw git output. `log` lines are `<hash>\t<ISO date>\t<author>\t<subject>`.

truncated.description: `true` when the output was cut at 256 KiB; `note` says how to narrow it.

Info.description: Overview of this machine and what this token may do here.

agents.description: Configured agents. Only agents listed in a workspace's `agents` may be started there.

default_runner.description: Runner used when a start request does not choose one.

external_sessions.description: Whether sessions running outside tmux can take input (experimental).

workspaces.description: Folders this bridge exposes. A workspace covers its `path` and everything below it.

InputRequest.description: Input for a session: text, keys, or both (text first).

keys.description:
tmux sessions only: keys to press, e.g. `["Down", "Enter"]` or `["1"]` to answer a menu.
Allowed: `Enter`, `Escape`, `Tab`, `BTab`, `Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`, `PageUp`,
`PageDown`, `Home`, `End`, `Space`, `BSpace`, `DC`, `C-c`, `C-d`, or one printable
character.

submit.description: tmux sessions only: press Enter after pasting `text` (default `true`).

text.description:
Message to the agent, at most 100 000 bytes. In tmux it is pasted as one block and
submitted with Enter.

max_sessions.description: Sessions started by the bridge that may run at the same time.

max_wait_secs.description: Maximum `wait` for long-polling a session, in seconds.

requests_per_minute.description: Requests allowed per minute for this token.

agent_session_id.description:
The agent's own id for this conversation (Claude session id, Codex thread id, Hermes
session id). Pass it as `resume` to continue the conversation in a new session.

attach_command.description: How a person can open this session in a terminal.

controllable.description: Whether the session accepts input through this bridge.

cwd.description: Working directory (absolute); usable with the file and git endpoints.

last_message.description:
The agent's last answer. A headless session clears it when a new message is sent and
shows the newest progress message while the turn runs.

note.description: Hints about this session, e.g. why it cannot take input.

screen.description: The last lines of the terminal (only in `GET /v1/sessions/{id}`).

started_by_bridge.description: Started through this bridge (only those can be stopped with `DELETE`).

waiting_for.description: What the agent waits for when `state` is `waiting`, e.g. `permission prompt`.

SessionList.description: Sessions in the workspaces this token may see.

warnings.description: Sources that could not be queried; the list is incomplete when this is not empty.

agent.description: Agent name from `GET /v1/info`, allowed in that workspace.

bypass_permissions.description:
Run without permission prompts (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions`). Needs
`allow_bypass_permissions` on the workspace.

cwd.description: Existing directory (absolute path) inside a workspace with the `start` capability.

keep_alive.description:
`true` (default) keeps the session after it answers. `false` closes it once the first
answer is in; the answer stays readable in `last_message`. In tmux this needs an agent
that reports finished turns (Claude Code, Codex).

model.description:
Model, passed with the agent's model flag (e.g. `opus`, `gpt-6.1-sol`). Replaces a model
set in the agent's configured `args`.

prompt.description:
First message to the agent, at most 100 000 bytes (8 000 in tmux, where it travels on
tmux's command line; send longer text as input once the session runs).

resume.description:
Continue an earlier conversation held in this same folder: the agent's session id
(`agent_session_id`).

oneOf.description:
`tmux` for a live terminal session (a person can attach to it), `headless` for one
non-interactive run per message. Default: the bridge's configured runner.

available.description: Whether tmux sessions can be started and controlled.

agents.description: Agents that may be started here.

allow.description: What clients may do in this folder.

allow_bypass_permissions.description: Whether sessions may be started with `bypass_permissions: true`.
